description:
Healing Music | Sarangi for Emotional Release | 1.5 Hours

If your chest feels heavy and you've been holding it in too long — start here. 1.5 hours of slow sarangi for emotional release.

Some feelings don't need solving. They need company. The sarangi is the most vocal-like instrument in Indian classical music. Let it speak for what you can't.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Sarangi — bowed Indian string instrument with breath-like vocal quality
- Long melodic phrases with natural breathing pauses
- A gentle healing frequency layer for the nervous system
- Unbroken sound — no abrupt fades, no startling moments

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling — softening into the body
12:00  First wave rising
35:00  Letting it move
60:00  Tender ground
80:00  Held & home

🧠 How to use:
Press play. Let whatever rises rise. The music holds you while the feeling moves. Don't analyze it — just breathe through it. Tears are welcome. So is silence.

⏱ Best for:
• Emotional release / grief processing
• After a hard day or hard conversation
• Heart-opening practice
• Tender wind-down
• Mid-week emotional reset

📺 Subscribe to Raga Focus for daily uploads:
- Sitar, Sarangi, Veena, Surbahar, Bansuri, Tanpura and other Indian instruments
- Music for anxiety, overthinking, sleep, stress, emotional release

— Raga Focus

Same Pichwai/Kangra border + parchment palette for channel consistency. Palette shifts to softer dawn-gold (post-tears, morning-after feel) instead of dusk-indigo. Central figure: same woman in cream-and-gold sari, but seated UPRIGHT with head slightly raised toward soft golden light through window, shoulders relaxed (visual relief cue), hands resting open on lap, single butterfly or rising lotus petal as gentle outcome cue, willow tree in soft light. Bold dark-teal serif overlay text reading 'FEEL LIGHTER' top-center, same typography. Tender resolved mood (AFTER the release). Same composition principles, no clutter.

Key visual difference: Variant A = pre-release contemplative weight; Variant B = post-release lightness/relief.
